professionalSummary.text: Runs the daily nostro reconciliation cycle in a reconciliation tool.
professionalSummary.witness: Ran the daily matching cycle for 38 nostro accounts at Penhallow Commercial Bank in the reconciliation tool, starting from the overnight statement load.

experienceHighlights.text: Investigates and clears unmatched items with correspondent banks within the escalation timelines.
experienceHighlights.witness: Investigated unmatched items by raising queries with correspondent banks over SWIFT and escalated anything open for more than 10 days to the team supervisor, as the escalation procedure required.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Tunes auto-matching rules through a controlled change process with test evidence.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Rewrote six auto-matching rules for card-scheme settlement entries; each change went through the change board with test results from the tool's rule simulator.

skills.text: Shows a measured reduction in aged open items from month-end reports.
skills.witness: Open items older than 30 days across the 38 accounts fell from 1,146 at the end of March 2023 to 287 at the end of September 2023, according to the tool's month-end ageing reports.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish the candidate's ability to run the daily reconciliation cycle, investigate unmatched items, tune auto-matching rules, and show a reduction in aged open items. They do not establish the candidate's ability to prepare the monthly open-items report for the operations risk committee.

decisionBoundary.statement: The materials provide evidence for some requirements but not all, and require further human review to determine the candidate's suitability for the role.

evidence.text: Ran the daily matching cycle for 38 nostro accounts at Penhallow Commercial Bank in the reconciliation tool, starting from the overnight statement load.
Investigated unmatched items by raising queries with correspondent banks over SWIFT and escalated anything open for more than 10 days to the team supervisor, as the escalation procedure required.
Rewrote six auto-matching rules for card-scheme settlement entries; each change went through the change board with test results from the tool's rule simulator.
Open items older than 30 days across the 38 accounts fell from 1,146 at the end of March 2023 to 287 at the end of September 2023, according to the tool's month-end ageing reports.
Drafted the monthly open-items paper for the operations risk committee, with ageing buckets and commentary on the largest breaks.
